title: Mallard Duck Movement
text:
Lake Constance lies in central Europe, where Germany, Switzerland, and Austria meet. This site explores GPS tracking data for mallards from 2007 to 2017, provided by the PPBDS misc.tutorials project.
The recorded fixes range from 47.3°N to 53.9°N and 7.8°E to 23.6°E, showing how far some birds traveled north and east of Lake Constance. Autumn has the most recorded fixes, especially September; fix counts describe the tracking records, not necessarily how often the ducks were moving. Explore the Map and Seasons pages from the navbar to see the locations and monthly patterns.
